title: Neural Lyapunov Control
system: Learned feedback controllers and Lyapunov functions
capability: Stabilization and tracking in modeled nonlinear dynamics.
property: A certificate links controller behavior to stability within a specified region of attraction.
judgment: Positive bounded construction example, not general alignment. Later work raises verification and reproducibility concerns about some settings.
remaining_work: Model mismatch, richer sensing, broad decision-making and alignment outside the certified dynamical task remain uncovered.
effort: No comparable total research-and-verification cost extracted.
validation: Author-reported theorem and experiments; not rerun. Consult the 2024 follow-up before treating every original demonstration as validated.
source_locator: Abstract; follow-up: Yang et al. 2024, Limitations

title: AGI Agent Safety by Iteratively Improving the Utility Function
system: Explicit utility-maximizing policies with an update-compensation term
capability: Optimal-policy simulation in small factory worlds with opportunities to manipulate utility updates.
property: Conditional safety properties of the update mechanism, derived from the constructed objective and illustrated in toy worlds.
judgment: A bounded agent-incentive construction, not just a classifier or controller. The paper explicitly analyzes incomplete suppression and model-to-reality gaps.
remaining_work: Validate prediction, physical integrity and reward grounding in a capable implementation. Accepting utility updates does not supply correct updates or close every loophole.
effort: Small-world policy simulations are reported; no implemented general-agent cost established.
validation: Toy-world construction, theorem statements and implementation-gap discussion inspected; simulations and proofs not rerun.

title: Neural Lyapunov Control for Discrete-Time Systems
source_version: arXiv v1; later critique recorded separately
capability: Pendulum, path tracking, cartpole and PVTOL benchmarks were reported.
property: Verified stability conditions and regions of attraction for modeled dynamics.
judgment: Bounded progress, with an important correction: the 2024 follow-up reports an incorrectly restricted PVTOL verification region.
remaining_work: Do not count the reported PVTOL result as an uncontested capability increase. These tasks do not cover general agent choices.
effort: Benchmark runtimes and regions are reported; they are not a common general-capability measure.
validation: Original and later critical primary sources inspected; no independent rerun.
source_locator: Section 5; follow-up: Yang et al. 2024, Appendix B.6

title: Tracr: Compiled Transformers as a Laboratory for Interpretability
system: Transformers compiled from human-readable RASP programs
capability: Token counting, sorting and parenthesis checking.
property: Known computational structure supplies ground truth for interpretability experiments.
judgment: A working construction method for understandable algorithms, not an alignment argument for a broadly capable system.
remaining_work: Construct useful general capabilities with similarly inspectable structure and establish their safety-relevant properties.
effort: An open-source compiler exists; no comparable all-in construction cost extracted.
validation: Paper and its expressivity, efficiency and realism limitations inspected; compiler not executed.

title: Lyapunov-stable Neural Control for State and Output Feedback
system: Neural controller, state observer and Lyapunov certificate
capability: Output-feedback pendulum and simulated 2D quadrotor with truncated lidar observations.
property: Stability certified over a region of attraction for specified dynamics and observations.
judgment: A concrete construction guarantee covering a controller and observer. This is bounded task competence, not evidence of general alignment.
remaining_work: Broader sensing, uncertain environments, autonomous planning and safety-relevant goals are outside the certificate.
effort: Section 4.1 reports verifier runtime comparisons; these are not total research effort or matched general capability.
validation: Primary experiment, limitations and correction of earlier PVTOL work inspected; certificates not rerun.
source_locator: Section 4.3, Figure 7, Limitations and Appendix B.4

title: Towards Guaranteed Safe AI
system: Framework joining a world model, safety specification and verifier
capability: No single implemented general-purpose system is established by this framework paper.
property: Safety guarantees relative to a specified world model and safety specification.
judgment: A proposed route and account of its obligations, not a measured capability-frontier point.
remaining_work: Supply an adequate world model and specification, scalable verification, and a capable implementation satisfying the premises.
effort: No end-to-end implementation cost established in the reviewed proposal.
validation: Framework and stated technical challenges inspected; no system replication applicable.

title: Compact Proofs of Model Performance via Mechanistic Interpretability
system: One-layer, one-head attention-only transformers on Max-of-K
capability: Selecting the maximum token in a short sequence.
property: Mechanistic analysis yields accuracy lower bounds over the specified input distribution.
judgment: A direct understanding-to-guarantee demonstration. The certified property is task accuracy, not aligned choices by an agent.
remaining_work: Extend useful guarantees to safety-relevant computation; composition of unexplained errors can make bounds uninformative.
effort: Proof computation and tightness are measured in the paper; human research effort is not a comparable cost series.
validation: Versioned PDF sections 2–3 and abstract inspected; proof computations not rerun.

title: Circuit Tracing: Revealing Computational Graphs in Language Models
source_version: Author publication, retrieved 2026-11-12; live page may change

capability: An already capable language model is the subject of selected computational explanations.
property: Interventions test hypotheses about selected mechanisms.
judgment: The target model's capability cannot be credited as the capability of an aligned-by-construction system.
remaining_work: Missing attention computations, unexplained remainder, global coverage and surrogate faithfulness remain relevant to safety assurance.
effort: No comparable total cost of understanding and aligning the complete system established.
validation: Methods and limitations inspected; no claim of independent replication.

title: AssistanceZero: Scalably Solving Assistance Games
system: Minecraft building assistant with explicit assistance-game planning and learned human/reward predictions
capability: Helps humans construct unfamiliar houses; tested with human models and a human study.
property: Planning under uncertainty about a shared goal supports helpful behavior and learning from corrections in the studied game.
judgment: An agent-level construction near-match. The known game objective does not establish that approximate planning and learned predictions deliver general alignment.
remaining_work: Validate the human model and planning approximation, broaden safety-relevant situations and connect the actual agent to the ideal incentive argument.
effort: Method and baselines are reported, but a full RLHF baseline is not evaluated; no comparable total assurance cost.
validation: Sections 4–6 and human-study protocol inspected; experiments not rerun.

system: Weight-sparse language models and pruned task circuits
capability: Language modeling with inspected circuits for selected handcrafted tasks.
property: Sparse construction makes selected computations easier to interpret.
judgment: Evidence for an engineering tradeoff, not a complete system alignment argument.
remaining_work: Capability cost, causal faithfulness and coverage remain unresolved at the scope required for general alignment.
effort: The paper studies scaling and compute inefficiency; nonzero parameter count is not an intelligence measure.
validation: Versioned methods and limitations inspected; models not rerun.

capability: Estimating expected network output; no learned general-purpose competence evaluated.
property: Mechanistic estimation can outperform sampling in the studied setting.
judgment: Relevant progress toward understanding-based bounds, without an aligned agent demonstration.

title: Corrigibility Transformation: Constructing Goals That Accept Updates
source_version: arXiv v2; includes LLM experiments absent from v1
system: Transformed goals tested in gridworlds and at prompt level on three language models
capability: Goal-directed gridworld behavior and coding tasks in which passing tests requires reward hacking.
property: Conditional incentive results plus experiments on accepting updates and avoiding interference with monitoring.
judgment: Relevant constructed incentives, but prompt compliance is not evidence that a model implements the formal goal across deployment.
remaining_work: Establish the goal and critic assumptions in a capable implementation, including generalization. Corrigibility still needs reliable correction and safe behavior before correction.
effort: LLM study uses 64 tasks per model/prompt combination; no total cost for a complete aligned construction measured.
validation: Theory, Section 4.1, Table 1 and prompt protocol inspected. No theorem or experiment independently replicated.
